tasks.label: Flash firmware
tasks.command: st-flash write Bootloader/build/bootloader.bin 0x08000000; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; st-flash --reset write build/hover.bin 0x08004000

tasks.label: Flash firmware (probe-rs)
tasks.command: probe-rs download Bootloader/build/bootloader.bin --chip STM32F103RC --binary-format bin --base-address 0x08000000; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; probe-rs download build/hover.bin --chip STM32F103RC --binary-format bin --base-address 0x08004000 --verify; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; probe-rs reset --chip STM32F103RC
